---
title: "About"
---

I am Shiqian Ma, a professor in the Data Science and AI Institute, Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics, Department of Computer Science, and Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, 
at Johns Hopkins University.

My research focuses on mathematical foundations of AI, foundation models, AI4Math, optimization and machine learning. 

In this blog, I share research notes, explanations of mathematical
ideas, and thoughts on optimization, machine learning, and AI for
mathematical discovery.

[Visit my academic homepage](https://shiqianma.github.io/)
